`final class SystemClockBridge`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IClockBridge`](/reference/bridges/iclockbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.clock` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SystemClockBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/clock/SystemClockBridge.java)

The default clock, which returns the time of the JVM.

## Description

JOID registers it in `BridgeHandler.CLOCK` before any backend.

- [Clock bridge](/build/bridges/clock/)
